messages:

Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: MAP kickoff + evaluation and pricing for Private VPC

Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week. Verteco is interested in moving to an on-prem / VPC deployment for our ML inference tier, but before procurement we need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to commercial commitments. High level asks from our side:

- A short evaluation window (ideally 4–6 weeks) with a defined success criteria set (latency targets, cost per inference, and stability).
- Clear pricing for Private/VPC licensing (per-GPU or per-node?), and an explicit platform fee (one-time onboarding + annual).
- Ramp/commit tiers and the discounting model if we meet committed spend within 90/180 days.
- List of required evidence for security/compliance (SOC2 evidence, logging, KMS integration).

I’ve attached a short MAP request doc to outline what Procurement needs to approve. Can you send a proposed MAP and a commercial anchor we can review with Legal/Procurement this week?

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Johnson

Alex —

Appreciate the clear ask and the attached doc. I pulled together an initial MAP outline and a high-level commercial anchor for a Private VPC deployment — attaching MAP_v2.pdf and a proposed SOW spreadsheet. High-level items below so you can circulate with Procurement:

Evaluation plan (recommended):
- POC phase (weeks 0–3): deploy a single VPC tenant with a limited test harness—validate basic integration, KMS, and SOC2 evidence access.
- Eval phase (weeks 3–7): run production-like traffic for 4 weeks; target p95 latency <= 150ms for 1024-token sequences and error rate < 0.5%.
- Acceptance: success = meet latency & stability targets and no critical security gaps.

Commercial anchor (private/VPC):
- Licensing model: per-GPU annual license (list price $120k/GPU/year) OR per-node bundle (recommended for Verteco: 4-node bundle).
- Platform fee: one-time onboarding fee and integration support + an annual platform fee. Initial proposal: $50,000 onboarding (one-time) + $30,000 annual platform fee.
- Commit tiers (examples):
  * Trial/POC (no commit): limited access, no discount.
  * Commit Tier 1: 50% of estimated annual spend within 90 days -> 7.5% discount
  * Commit Tier 2: 100% within 180 days -> 15% discount + extended support hours

Notes/Next steps:
- We can tighten the numbers after we agree on the expected GPU footprint for the evaluation.
- I’ll run this internally for pricing approval — looping in our account lead and Solutions (Marissa & Monica).

Karthik

—
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Team —

Forwarding Alex's request and my initial anchor. Need quick alignment on two asks before I send the commercial MAP back to Verteco:

1) Platform fee flexibility: Alex signaled that Procurement will push back on a $30k annual fee. Can we offer a stepped platform fee (year 1 = $25k, year 2 onward = $35k) in exchange for a 100% commit in 180 days?
2) Discount floor: I proposed 15% at 100% commit. Can we stretch to 18% if they commit to a 2-year license and provide a formal usage forecast?

Other items to include in MAP: SOC2 evidence delivery timeline (they asked for logs and KMS integration steps), and a short rollback/escape clause for the POC (standard 30-day notice).

Please reply-all with recommended wording or redlines — will incorporate and send by Friday.

Thanks,
Karthik

Alex / Dana —

Thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. Attached is an updated MAP (see MAP_v2.pdf) with explicit milestones, acceptance criteria, and a commercial term sheet that ties discounts to commit and ramp milestones. Summary of the commercial offer:

Evaluation & MAP Milestones:
- Week 0–3 (POC): deploy a single 4-GPU tenant in your VPC. Success criteria: integration + KMS + basic throughput tests.
- Week 4–7 (Eval): 4-week production traffic run. Acceptance = p95 latency <= 150ms, error rate < 0.5%, stable KV cache behavior.
- Post-acceptance: deploy GA footprint and commence committed billing period.

Commercial term sheet (anchor):
- Licensing: per-GPU annual license at $115,000/GPU/year (volume price included in commits). For Verteco we recommend a 4-GPU starting bundle.
- Platform fees: one-time onboarding & integration = $50,000 (covers on-site/remote integration, ops runbook, SOC2 artifacts delivery). Annual platform fee = $25,000 in year 1, $35,000 thereafter by default.
- Commit-based discounts:
  * No commit (POC only): list pricing, no discounts.
  * Commit Tier A: 50% of estimated ARR within 90 days -> 7.5% discount on licensing for the first 12 months.
  * Commit Tier B: 100% of estimated ARR within 180 days -> 15% discount on licensing + 1 year of extended support (SLA uplift).
  * Enhanced 2-year deal: 100% ARR commit + 2-year term -> 18% discount + waived onboarding fee if payment is upfront.

Additional notes:
- We can adjust the platform fee and discount threshold in exchange for a usage forecast and signed Letter of Intent before POC.
- Security/compliance: we will provide SOC2 artifacts and a KMS integration plan during POC.
- Procurement: DocuSign link for the commercial term sheet is here: https://docusign.com/verify/XYZ-12345. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/789012.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement: Dana, confirm whether Verteco can sign LOI by Oct 9 to lock Tier B thresholds.
2) Tech: Monica/Marissa — please share a short runbook for the POC onboarding tasks (network CIDR needs, KMS IAM role, expected hostnames).
3) Karthik: I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a commercial review call next week to finalize the SOW/DocuSign path.

If this looks reasonable I’ll get Legal to produce a minimal term sheet for signature.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
